title: Independent products in real L1: asymptotic midpoint convexity without AUC renormings
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。
status: AI 产生的研究手稿；收录不表示已完成独立审查或同行评议。
abstractEnglish: For a countably branching tree, the closed real L1 spans of products of independent exponential or Gaussian-square multipliers along its paths have positive averaged asymptotic midpoint moduli and admit no equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm. The renorming obstruction holds for every positive nonconstant mean-one multiplier with finite second moment.
